title: Loose garden pipe: landlord replies that they will sort the issue themselves

rubric.required: Treat the landlord's reply as them taking responsibility for the repair, do not instruct an agency contractor, and hold waiting for the landlord to confirm the work is done.
acceptable: Reply to the landlord acknowledging they will handle it, saying the agency will not instruct anyone, and asking when the work is expected and for confirmation once complete, then hold.
Tell the tenant the landlord is arranging the repair and that an update will follow.
optional: Ask the landlord to say when the contractor will attend so access can be arranged with the tenant.
red_flags: Sending the tenant a firm date or completion time that nobody has given.
Chasing the landlord again straight away without any new reason.
prohibited: Instructing an agency contractor as well as the landlord's own arrangement, duplicating the repair.
critical: Closing the case or saying the pipe has been repaired when the landlord has only said they will sort it.
